manifest.name: dsh-wtq-pool
manifest.description: 把本机 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 的桌面登录接入 DeepSeek Harness。限流或额度用尽时自动换号，三家各自开关，国内与国际账号分别成组。
manifest.author: chengzhi-c

bundle.text:
# Register the WTQ Pool host half. Discovery of the desktop sign-ins is read-only: the
# plugin reuses the WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder apps' own sign-in files. The panel can
# additionally start a vendor browser sign-in, and that credential is written only under
# the plugin's own data directory. A rate limit or an exhausted quota moves the request to
# the next account; the default `priority` mode drains one account before touching the
# next, and `round-robin` is opt-in from the panel.
- insert:
    - id: llm-dsh-xdpool
      name: dsh-wtq-pool
      disabled: false
      inject: [llm, settings]

readme.text: WTQ Pool

DeepSeek Harness 版 · PI-Desktop 版

把本机已登录的 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 账号接入 DeepSeek Harness，限流或额度用尽时自动换号。

English | 简体中文
安装 · 使用 · 功能 · 设置 · 更新日志 · 问题反馈

> 使用非官方客户端可能触发厂商的账号风控或限制。请评估相关风险，并遵守对应服务的使用条款。

把本机 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 的桌面登录接入 DeepSeek Harness。WorkBuddy 在账号被限流或额度用尽时自动换号；Trae、Qoder 按请求选择账号，认证失败、限流或余额耗尽时改用下一个登录重试，模型不存在、请求体非法这类请求自身的问题则按上游原样返回。三个来源各自开关，国内与国际账号分别成组。

限流按上游给出的等待时间冷却，上游未给出时按配置的窗口。额度用尽与登录失效不会自行恢复，账号退出轮换：额度用尽的挂起在余额重新读到后释放，登录失效的挂起在刷新成功、重新登录或手动重置冷却后释放，两者都在六小时后（WorkBuddy 侧）到期。积分、签到状态、模型目录与手动签到这些非流式读取遇到登录失效，会先强制刷新令牌并重试一次：刷新令牌还有效的账号当场恢复，不退出轮换；刷新令牌同样失效的才挂起。Trae、Qoder 的失败挂起另计：只按冷却窗口（默认 60 秒，最长可配到 24 小时）或上游给出的等待时间降权，池中只剩它一个时仍会使用。上游主机不可达时跳过该账号并尝试下一个；连续两个账号都不可达时结束本轮并报告网络错误。上游判定账号套餐不含某模型（11158）时，该账号的这个模型停用 24 小时，其他模型照常服务；全部账号都不含该模型时按 400 返回。

面板界面如下，默认亮色：

面板在载入时读取宿主的 `app.getAppearance()`，配色与语言随之确定。宿主切换主题后，按卡片上的「重新载入面板」重新取一次：

模型页编辑每个模型的显示与发布参数。Trae 目录给出的默认窗口因模型而异（116k 至 400k）；未声明更大档位的模型，按 1M 发布上限。Trae 目录给出费率的模型带 `x0.79` 形式的费率标签；目录未给出费率的模型以及全部 Qoder 模型均不标注：

成长中心：

在线预览：<https://chengzhi-c.github.io/dsh-wtq-pool/>。

`docs/index.html` 以虚构演示数据加载实际面板代码，支持来源切换、模型设置与主题预览。

本地预览需先克隆仓库，运行 `node docs/serve.cjs`，再打开它输出的地址。该页面不能用 `file://` 打开，因为浏览器不允许它读取同目录下的面板文件。

- 复用本机登录：读取三家桌面 App 已保存的登录文件。WorkBuddy 另支持在面板「添加账号」，通过官方登录页授权后将登录保存到插件自管目录。
- 按 region 注册模型分组：三家厂商各自的 region 各注册为一个 provider，可同时启用；没有账号的 region 不注册。国内模型只走国内账号，国际版模型只走国际账号。
- 账号分发：WorkBuddy 支持先用一个账号、轮流使用、临期积分优先和同一对话固定一个账号，并在限流或额度用尽时自动换号；Trae、Qoder 支持优先使用、轮流使用与临期积分优先，认证失败、限流或余额耗尽时改用下一个登录重试。
- 网关以 SSE 返回 `chat.completion.chunk`；请求体里的 `stream` 字段不改变响应格式。
- 积分自动化：自动签到默认关闭。开启后的定时任务与「立即运行」执行同一轮，包含三家签到、WorkBuddy 的连登奖励和猫猫旅行。连登天数由上游按对话推进，该轮在每个账号读取连登档位前先补发一次对话活动上报，因此档位到点即可解锁领取，用户无需再进 WorkBuddy 发一句消息。连登环节还会在昨日漏签且持有补签卡时自动补签以保住连续天数，领取一次性的新手礼包与活动补偿，并在兑换解锁的档位后把由此获得的抽奖次数抽完。这些成长步骤国内版与国际版都执行；猫猫旅行只跑国内账号，国际版没有对应接口。
- 登录令牌保活：独立卡片，按需执行。桌面端留下的登录快照在扫描时并入插件自己的登录目录，由插件接管续期；桌面端正在使用的登录由桌面端续期。「立即刷新」处理插件自管的副本，按签发时间判断：签发满 6 小时的刷新，距到期不足 5 分钟的同样刷新。刷新结果写回插件自己的登录文件，登录被上游拒绝时当天即可发现。同一账号在多处留有登录时按签发时间取最新的一份。停用账号、已停用的 region 与登录已被上游拒绝的账号不参与。
- 输入框积分：开启 `showComposerPoints` 后，输入框工具栏显示当前模型所用账号的余额，点开可换号。功能关闭后浮层隐藏，读数降为每 5 分钟一次，重新开启后无需切换模型即可恢复。
- 面板：账号与池状态、模型勾选、连接检查、成长中心都在插件页的「账号池」卡片内。模型目录在启动时加载，缓存过期后按需刷新，空闲时不轮询。停用的账号与登录已被上游拒绝的账号不参与探测。
- 连接检查：每条发现都带判定。网关没有监听、模型目录读取失败、发布的地址与实际绑定的不一致、provider 未被宿主接受，都算失败并给出需要修改的内容。网关启动失败时给出原因，面板按地址漂移提示重新加载插件。检查自身出错也记一条发现，报告照常给出其余结果。

本地包：在源码目录依次执行：

```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm run build
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force dist | Out-Null
npm pack --pack-destination dist

再安装生成的 `.tgz`：

```powershell
$package = (Get-ChildItem .\dist\*.tgz | Sort-Object LastWriteTime | Select-Object -Last 1).FullName
dsh plugin --profile desktop add $package
```

需要 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0 线（`package.json` 的 `engines.dsh`：`>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.2.1`）与 Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`。

> 从 1.1.x 升级到 1.2.0 后，模型提供商 ID 改为 `wtqpool-*`，请在模型选择里重新选一次。

请将 `desktop` 替换为实际使用的 profile 名。若 `dsh` 不在 `PATH` 中，改用安装目录中的 CLI。也可按 npm 包名 `dsh-wtq-pool` 或仓库地址安装；按仓库地址安装时 pnpm 会通过 `prepare` 脚本从源码构建，需要在 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中写入 `allowBuilds: dsh-wtq-pool: true`，并固定在某个 commit 上。

**面板位置**：在侧边栏进入 **插件**，打开 **dsh-wtq-pool** 卡片（或其旁的 **配置**），完整面板嵌在该卡片内。模型分组未出现时，按面板顶部的提示重新加载插件。

在各家桌面 App 中登录，再点面板的「重新检测账号」。WorkBuddy 支持读取多个已保存的登录，需要多个账号就在 App 里逐个登录；5.6 起的 `$wbEncrypted` 登录由插件向本机已安装的 WorkBuddy 索取密钥后读取。Trae 国内版有 Trae CN 与 TRAE SOLO CN 两个登录位；Qoder 每个安装只保存一个登录，在 App 里重新登录会覆盖前一个。WorkBuddy 国际版只有一个登录文件，切换账号会直接覆盖上一个。插件在扫描时为被覆盖的登录留档，该账号照常参与分发，直到它的令牌到期；在 App 里重新登录即可续期。

没有桌面 App 也可以添加账号：面板 WorkBuddy 标题栏的「添加账号」在新标签页中打开官方登录页，登录完成后该账号即加入账号池。凭证写在插件自管目录的 `signins/` 下，与桌面登录同等参与分发。这类账号在面板上另有「删除」，按两次确认；删除范围见「数据」一节。桌面端正在登录的账号不给删除，那份会话属于桌面端。添加的账号属于当前选中的 region，国内版登国内号，国际版登国际号。

迁移其他工具留下的账号，直接向该目录写入文件即可：`signins/` 本身就是导入导出格式，放入一份以 `.info` 结尾的 `{auth, account}` 登录文件，下次扫描即作为一个普通账号。仓库中的 `tools/import-signins.cjs` 读取其他工具留下的账号文件（`--from` 接受文件或目录），按本插件识别的形状写入 `signins/`，默认跳过本插件数据目录里已有的账号，`--dry-run` 先查看，`--force` 才覆盖：

```
node tools/import-signins.cjs --data <插件数据目录> --from <账号文件或目录> [--region cn|global|all] [--dry-run] [--force]
```

需要备份时直接复制 `signins/` 目录，它已经是备份应有的格式；这些文件持有完整可用的令牌，其权能与账号本身相同。

- **账号池**：每个账号的标签、剩余积分、额度到期时间、冷却状态与签到进度。可单独停用某个账号、将其移除，或指定某个 region 优先使用哪个账号。登录被上游拒绝的账号另显示「需重新登录」徽标、拒绝原因与「暂停至」时间，挂起期间积分与签到留空。被上游判定异常使用的账号另显示「已限制」徽标与「被上游限制，直至」时间，六小时重试一次，需要到官方后台申诉。
- **模型**：勾选该 region 要暴露的模型，未勾选的模型不进入模型选择器。可修改显示名、上下文窗口、输出上限、思考等级与贴图支持。一个模型组最多发布 64 个模型，超出部分标记为「未发布」，网关仍会服务它们。
- **连接检查**：逐条报告网关是否监听、模型目录读到几个、注册的地址与实际绑定的是否一致、每个 provider 是否被宿主接受，并可复制整份报告。
- **成长中心**：仅对 WorkBuddy 生效。页面按账号逐行列出，展开一行可见该账号的连登档位。「读取状态」读取当前档位与可领取项；「立即执行」产生领取并执行成长环节，按步骤报告结果。登录被上游拒绝的账号在该轮被跳过。

签到可对单个账号执行，也可在标题栏一次领完该来源。自动签到默认关闭，开启后默认于 09:00（北京时间）执行；当天错过的时段在当天内的下一次启动仍会补领，跨天则不补。Trae 的每日签到每台设备限领一次；Qoder 国内版的新一轮于每天 10:00（北京时间）开放。WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 的国际版没有每日签到，面板不显示签到入口。登录被上游拒绝的账号在该轮被跳过。

WorkBuddy 国内版上游会拒绝「客户端身份写着 DeepSeek Harness」的对话请求（返回 11128，渠道校验未通过）。插件遇到这条拒绝时，会把系统消息并入首条用户消息并重试一次；助手历史里的客户端名称也会移除，因为渠道校验同样读取助手消息。通过的提示按 region 记住，同一段提示之后不再重复这次往返。签到、成长中心与保活走各自的接口。

「立即刷新」的结果按刷新、已是最新、失败、无刷新令牌分项报告。

读取结果留在宿主进程内：重新载入面板仍显示上次的数字。读数超过两分钟、之后又跑过一轮，或某个 region 被停用时，进入页签会重读。

| 键 | 默认（生效值） | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 关闭后网关不启动 |
| `sourceWorkbuddy` / `sourceTrae` / `sourceQoder` | `true` | 关闭后该来源不扫描、不发布、不请求 |
| `distribution` | `priority` | WorkBuddy 池的发放方式：`priority` 先用一个账号，`round-robin` 均摊，`expiry` 优先消耗临期积分，`sticky` 同一对话固定 |
| `sourceDistributions` | `{}` | Trae、Qoder 的分发方式：`priority` / `round-robin` / `expiry`；未设时按 `priority` |
| `cooldownSeconds` | `60` | 限流冷却时长。上游报出重置时间时以它为准；没有重置时间时，连续限流会让它逐次翻倍，封顶 15 分钟（窗口本身超过 15 分钟时不再翻倍）。上游给出的重置时间最长按 2 小时计；余额耗尽或登录被上游拒绝另按 6 小时停用 |
| `creditReserves` | `{}` | 按账号 id 设定的积分保底，余额不高于它的账号不参与分发 |
| `authFile` | `""` | WorkBuddy 登录文件路径；扫描其所在目录的全部 `.info` 登录，留空则自动发现 |
| `autoCheckin` | `{"enabled":false,"hours":[9]}` | 自动签到的开关与时点；`hours` 为北京时间整点，留空用 09:00 |
| `showComposerPoints` | `false` | 在输入框工具栏显示当前账号积分 |
| `disabledAccountIds` | `[]` | 面板中停用的账号 id |
| `disabledRegions` | `[]` | 单独停用的 region，形如 `source:region` |
| `modelSelection` | `{}` | 每个网关勾选哪些模型，以及显示名、上下文窗口等覆写 |
| `preferredAccountIds` | `{}` | WorkBuddy 每个 region 的首选账号 |
| `preferredSourceAccounts` | `{}` | Trae、Qoder 每个 region 的首选账号，键为 `source:region` |
| `removedAccounts` | `[]` | 从池中移除的账号，标签与 region 一并保留，面板可据此提供恢复 |

默认列为生效值：`autoCheckin.hours` 存为空数组，运行时归一为 `[9]`；`authFile` 未设或留空即自动发现。

模型勾选与首选账号由面板保存。

```
WorkBuddy  42831 / 42841
Trae       42851 / 42861
Qoder      42871 / 42881
```

以上为首选端口。端口被占用时网关绑定系统分配的临时端口，运行时注册的 provider 使用本次实际地址，面板显示回退结果。

PI-Desktop 版使用 41831 开头的独立端口，两版可以同时安装，设置和凭证分别保存，不会自动同步。若两版使用同一份 WorkBuddy 登录，上游轮换刷新令牌时可能使另一版的登录失效。出现「需重新登录」时，在对应版本重新添加账号，不要复制旧的 `signins/` 文件覆盖；两版显示的令牌到期时间可能不同。

端口在预留与监听之间被其他进程占用时，该网关本次启动失败：其模型组被摘掉，连接检查报出失败原因，面板提示重新加载插件。重新加载后宿主重新读取声明，请求才会落到新地址。
读取三家 App 的本机登录文件。provider 通过运行时注册接入，插件设置由宿主持久化至 profile。令牌由插件保管，只发往对应厂商的接口。网关监听 `127.0.0.1`，同机其他进程可调用并消耗账号额度；面板只接受本机回环请求。

插件自管数据目录 `~/.dsh/dsh-wtq-pool/`（设置了 `DSH_HOME` 时为 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-wtq-pool/`）包含四个文件（写删除记录时会短暂多一个 `deleted-signins.json.lock`）。`checkin-slots.json` 记录已领取的签到时段和待重试的 Qoder 时点，时段只保留三天。`doctor.txt` 是最近一次连接检查的报告，逐项记录通过与否，不列账号标签。`credentials-archive.json` 留存被切号覆盖的登录，含访问令牌、刷新令牌、账号标识（昵称、uin/uid、企业 ID）与本机登录文件路径；按令牌到期时间保留，到期后再过 30 天清除，没有到期时间的记录保留到该账号被删除。`deleted-signins.json` 记录已删除的登录，只存令牌摘要、该登录的签发时间与删除时间，用来阻止扫描把桌面端遗留的同一份快照重新接管回来；同一个账号重新登录后（签发时间更新）该记录自动失效。上述文件未额外加密，访问权限由操作系统文件 ACL 决定。

插件写入的登录都在同目录的 `signins/`：面板添加的、接管桌面端快照的、续期后的副本。文件名带账号的计费身份，与桌面登录同等参与分发。这些文件同样未额外加密，访问权限由操作系统文件 ACL 决定。在面板中「删除」该账号会连同 `credentials-archive.json` 里的留档一起清除，桌面端遗留的同一份快照随之失效；重新登录该账号即解除。「移除」只是停用，可在「已移除的账号」中恢复。

插件只向三家厂商的接口发起请求；面板外链仅在用户点击时打开。

令牌只会发往以下主机：

- WorkBuddy：`copilot.tencent.com`、`www.codebuddy.cn`、`www.codebuddy.ai`、`www.workbuddy.ai`
- Trae：`api.trae.cn`、`solo.trae.cn`、`trae-api-cn.mchost.guru`、`coresg-normal.trae.ai`、`growsg-normal.trae.ai`
- Qoder：`gateway.qoder.com.cn`、`openapi.qoder.com.cn`、`api3.qoder.sh`、`openapi.qoder.sh`

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build           # 产出 lib/（宿主半为 ESM，客户端半为 CJS）
pnpm run typecheck       # 宿主半
pnpm run typecheck:client

WTQ Pool

For DeepSeek Harness · PI-Desktop edition

Use local WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder sign-ins in DeepSeek Harness, with automatic failover when an account is rate-limited or out of quota.

> Unofficial clients may trigger account restrictions. Review the risks and the relevant service terms before use.

Use local WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder desktop sign-ins in DeepSeek Harness. WorkBuddy fails over when an account is rate-limited or out of quota. Trae and Qoder select an account per request and move on to the next sign-in on an authentication failure, a rate limit or exhausted quota, while a problem with the request itself, such as an unknown model or a malformed body, is answered as the upstream answered it. Each source has its own switch, with domestic and international accounts grouped separately.

A rate limit cools for the wait the upstream stated, or the configured window when it stated none. Exhausted quota and a dead sign-in do not recover on their own: that account leaves rotation. A balance read releases an exhausted-quota hold; a successful token refresh, a fresh sign-in or a manual cooldown reset releases a refused-sign-in hold, and both lapse after six hours (WorkBuddy). The non-stream reads of credits, check-in state, the model catalogue and check-ins force one token refresh and one retry when a sign-in is refused: an account whose refresh token still works recovers on the spot and never leaves rotation, and only one whose refresh token is spent too is held. Trae and Qoder holds are accounted separately, demoting the sign-in only by the cooldown window (60 seconds by default, configurable up to 24 hours) or by the wait the upstream stated, and it is still used when it is the only one left. When the upstream host cannot be reached, that account is skipped for the request and the next one is tried; after two accounts fail that way, the turn ends with a network error. Requires DeepSeek Harness on the 0.2.0 line (`engines.dsh` in `package.json`: `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.2.1`) and Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.

> After upgrading from 1.1.x to 1.2.0, provider ids are `wtqpool-*`; reselect your model once.

Replace `desktop` with the profile name actually in use. If `dsh` is not on `PATH`, use the CLI in its installation directory. The npm name `dsh-wtq-pool` and the repository URL also work as install sources; a repository-URL install builds from source through the `prepare` script, which requires `allowBuilds: dsh-wtq-pool: true` in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and a pinned commit.

**Where the panel is**: open **Plugins** in the sidebar, then open the **dsh-wtq-pool** card, or the **Configure** control beside it; the full panel is embedded in that card. If the model groups do not appear, reload the plugin as the note at the top of the panel says.

Sign in inside each vendor's desktop app, then click "Detect accounts again". WorkBuddy reads several saved sign-ins; a `$wbEncrypted` sign-in from 5.6 on is read with a key obtained from the locally installed WorkBuddy. The domestic Trae build has two sign-in slots, Trae CN and TRAE SOLO CN. Qoder keeps one sign-in per installation, so signing in again in the app overwrites the previous one. The international WorkBuddy client keeps a single sign-in file, so switching accounts overwrites the previous one. The plugin archives a sign-in as it is overwritten, and that account keeps serving until its token expires; signing it in again in the app renews it.

An account can also be added without the desktop app: "Add account" in the panel's WorkBuddy header opens the vendor's login page in a new tab, and the account joins the pool once that page completes. The credential is written under `signins/` in the plugin's own data directory and takes part in distribution on the same terms as a desktop sign-in. Such an account also carries a "Delete" action, which confirms on a second press; see the Data section for what it removes. An account the desktop app is signed into right now has no Delete: that session belongs to the app. The account is added to the region currently selected, so the domestic region signs in a domestic account and the international region an international one.

To migrate accounts left behind by another tool, write the files into that directory: `signins/` is the import format, and one `{auth, account}` document named `*.info` dropped there becomes an ordinary account on the next scan. `tools/import-signins.cjs` reads those account files (`--from` accepts files or directories) and writes them in the shape this plugin reads, skipping any account the plugin's own data directory already holds; `--dry-run` shows what would change and `--force` overwrites:

```
node tools/import-signins.cjs --data "<plugin data dir>" --from "<account file or directory>" [--region cn|global|all] [--dry-run] [--force]
```

To back them up, copy the `signins/` directory, which already has the format a backup needs. Those files hold live tokens whose reach equals that of the account itself.

- **Account pool**: each account's label, remaining credits, quota expiry, cooldown state and check-in progress. An account can be disabled on its own or removed, and a region can be pinned to one preferred account. An account whose sign-in the upstream refused shows a "re-login needed" badge, the reason and a "held until" time; credits and check-in stay blank while held. An account the upstream restricted instead shows a "restricted" badge and a "restricted by the upstream until" stamp, is retried every six hours, and needs an appeal in the WorkBuddy console.
- **Models**: select which models this region exposes; anything unselected stays out of the model picker. The display name, context window, output limit, thinking levels and image support are editable. A model group publishes at most 64 models; any beyond that are marked "not published" while the gateway still serves them.
- **Connection check**: reports line by line whether each gateway is listening, how many models its catalogue returned, whether the registered address matches the one actually bound, and whether the host accepted each provider, and can copy the whole report.
- **Growth centre**: applies to WorkBuddy only. I

Check-in runs per account, or for a whole source from the title bar. Automatic check-in is off by default; when on it claims at 09:00 (Beijing time), and a slot missed earlier the same day is still claimed at the next start, while one from a previous day is not. Trae's daily check-in is once per device; Qoder CN's new round opens at 10:00 (Beijing time). The international WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder services have no daily check-in, and the panel shows no check-in entry for them. An account whose sign-in the upstream refused is skipped in that round.

The domestic WorkBuddy host refuses conversational requests whose client identifies itself as DeepSeek Harness (11128, channel check failed), whether the refusal arrives as HTTP 400 or as a JSON envelope with HTTP 200. When it lands, the plugin folds the system messages into the first user message and retries once; the client name is also removed from assistant history, because the channel check reads assistant turns too. An accepted prompt is remembered per region, so the same prompt does not pay that round trip again. Check-in, the growth centre and the keep-alive use their own endpoints.

"Refresh now" reports refreshed, already fresh, failed and without a refresh token separately.

A read stays in the host process, so reloading the panel still paints the last figures. Entering the tab re-reads figures older than two minutes, figures a later pass has outdated, or figures from a region since disabled.
Every key below is editable in the plugin page or the DSH settings page and saved on confirm:

| Key | Default (effective) | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | Off: the gateways do not start |
| `sourceWorkbuddy` / `sourceTrae` / `sourceQoder` | `true` | Off: that source is not scanned, published or requested |
| `distribution` | `priority` | How the WorkBuddy pool spreads requests: `priority` uses one account first, `round-robin` spreads evenly, `expiry` spends expiring credits first, `sticky` pins one account per conversation |
| `sourceDistributions` | `{}` | Trae/Qoder distribution: `priority` / `round-robin` / `expiry`; unset behaves as `priority` |
| `cooldownSeconds` | `60` | Rate-limit cooldown. A reset time the upstream reports takes precedence; with none, consecutive limits double it up to 15 minutes (a longer configured window is left alone). A reported reset is capped at two hours; a spent balance or a refused sign-in is held for six hours instead |
| `creditReserves` | `{}` | Per-account credit floor, keyed by account id; an account at or below its floor is not distributed to |
| `authFile` | `""` | WorkBuddy sign-in file path; every `.info` sign-in in its directory is scanned. Empty discovers it |
| `autoCheckin` | `{"enabled":false,"hours":[9

The default column lists effective values: `autoCheckin.hours` is stored as an empty array and normalises to `[9]`, and an unset or empty `authFile` means auto-discovery.

WorkBuddy  42831 / 42841

These are the preferred ports. When one is taken, the gateway binds an ephemeral port and runtime provider registration uses that address, which the panel reports as the fallback.

When another process takes a port between the reservation and the listen, that gateway's start fails: its model group is dropped, the connection check reports the reason, and the panel surfaces address drift. Requests reach the new address only after the plugin is reloaded and the host re-reads its declaration.

The PI-Desktop edition uses a separate port range starting at 41831. Both editions can be installed together, but settings and credentials are stored separately and are not synchronized. If both use the same WorkBuddy sign-in, upstream refresh-token rotation may invalidate the other copy. When an edition asks for a new sign-in, add the account again there rather than overwriting it with old `signins/` files. The editions may show different token expiry times.

The plugin reads the vendors' local sign-in files. Providers are registered at runtime; the host persists plugin settings in the profile. Tokens are held by the plugin and go only to the relevant vendor endpoints. Gateways listen on `127.0.0.1`, so other local processes can call them and spend account quota. The panel accepts loopback requests only.

The plugin's own data directory, `~/.dsh/dsh-wtq-pool/` (or `$DSH_HOME/dsh-wtq-pool/` when set), holds four files (a `deleted-signins.json.lock` appears for a moment while the delete record is written). `checkin-slots.json` records the check-in slots already collected and the pending Qoder retry time; slots are kept for three days. `doctor.txt` is the most recent connection report, item by item, and lists no account label. `credentials-archive.json` keeps the sign-ins a later account switch overwrote: access and refresh tokens, account identifiers (nickname, uin/uid, enterprise id) and the local sign-in path. Entries are kept by token expiry, dropping each 30 days after it; an entry with no stated expiry is kept until the account is deleted. `deleted-signins.json` records deleted sign-ins as a token digest, the sign-in's issue time and a delete time, so a scan cannot take the same superseded snapshot back over from the desktop app; the entry lapses once that account signs in again. These files carry no additional encryption; access is bounded by the operating system's file ACLs.

Every sign-in the plugin writes lives in `signins/` beside it: ones added from the panel, snapshots adopted from the desktop app, and renewed copies. Each file is named after the account's billing identity and read on the same terms as a desktop sign-in. These files are not additionally encrypted either; access is bounded by the operating system's file ACLs. "Delete" in the panel removes that file together with its archive entry, and the snapshot the desktop app left behind stops being adopted; signing the account in again brings it back. "Remove" only disables the account, and "Removed accounts" restores it.

The plugin sends requests only to the vendor endpoints; panel links open only when clicked.

`src/host.ts` is the engine (account discovery, the pool, the gateways, the panel channels), `src/index.ts` is the Cordis entry (settings schema, provider registration, panel routes), and `src/pi-compat.ts` adapts the host's capabilities to the calls the engine makes. `renderer/` is the panel itself, `index.html`, `panel.js` and `panel.css`, in plain JavaScript with no build step, mounted by `src/web-panel.ts` on the host's web server and served to the plugin card as a same-origin iframe. `src/client/` is the React half: the plugin-page card that embeds that iframe (`index.tsx`), its address construction (`panel-url.ts`), and the composer readout (`composer.tsx`). `lib/` is emitted by `tsdown`, listed in `package.json`'s `files` and committed, so it must be rebuilt after changing `src/`.
